raw.rationale: This compound is a norepinephrine transporter (SLC6A2) inhibitor rather than a directly cytotoxic agent, so at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is unlikely to produce lineage-selective killing; PRISM single-concentration screens of such drugs typically show weak, non-selective viability effects. Any apparent selectivity would be rare and driven by SLC6A2 expression differences, which are not a known lineage-selective dependency in these solid tumor lineages.
